source='''def transform(grid):
    """Restore masked cells from the grid's dihedral symmetries."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    n = len(grid)
    if any(len(row) != n for row in grid):
        raise ValueError("expected a square grid")
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            if grid[r][c] != 2:
                continue
            orbit = {
                (r, c), (c, r), (n - 1 - r, n - 1 - c),
                (n - 1 - c, n - 1 - r), (r, n - 1 - c),
                (n - 1 - r, c), (c, n - 1 - r), (n - 1 - c, r),
            }
            values = [grid[rr][cc] for rr, cc in orbit if grid[rr][cc] != 2]
            if not values or any(value != values[0] for value in values):
                raise ValueError(f"cannot infer masked cell at {(r, c)}")
            out[r][c] = values[0]
    return out
'''
